news.title: Everything you need to know about Kevin Warsh, Trump's pick to lead the Federal Reserve
news.description: Kevin Warsh, a former Fed governor, has emerged as Donald Trump’s pick to lead the Federal Reserve. Here’s his background, views and why it matters.

news.title: Silver drops 30%, gold tumbles 10% as Trump Warsh pick eases Fed independence fear, triggers dollar rally
news.description: Gold and silver prices plunged on Friday, following weeks of gains as investors poured money into safe havens.

news.title: Partial government shutdown on track for Saturday after Senate vote on funding deal stalled
news.description: The deal would address concerns Democrats have had about funding the Department of Homeland Security because of enforcement actions in Minnesota.
